name: Create a formatted Google Doc from Markdown

parameters.content:
## Markdown to Google Docs
Connect the same Google Drive OAuth2 credential to Create Google Doc and Read back Google Doc. Enable the Drive API.

Edit the example title and Markdown; optionally set a destination folder ID. Set createDocument to true when ready.

Creates one new document per manual run. A timeout may still create a document, so check Drive before retrying. Readback verifies file identity and type, not visual rendering. See the matching guide.
